proof_body:
by
  intro 𝕜 _ E _ _ F r hF hne hr
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ : ∃ z : E, z ∉ F := by
    by_contra h
    push Not at h
    exact hne (Submodule.eq_top_iff'.2 h)
  obtain ⟨x, _, h1, h2⟩ := riesz_lemma_of_lt_one hF ⟨z, hz⟩ hr
  exact ⟨x, h1, h2⟩
target_source: ∀ (𝕜 : Type*) [RCLike 𝕜] (E : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] (F : Submodule 𝕜 E) (r : ℝ), IsClosed (F : Set E) → F ≠ ⊤ → r < 1 → ∃ x : E, ‖x‖ = 1 ∧ ∀ y ∈ F, r ≤ ‖x - y‖
